data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): pin wrap site to the _call_with_retry(client.update_issue, ...) call at applier.py:418 — wrap only that call site in try/except JiraAPIError. Do NOT modify _call_with_retry itself; its 4xx fast-fail (applier.py:88-91) is depended on by other tests (e.g., test_applier_retry / test_applier_failure_injection). Comment-fallback returns a manifest discriminator dict: {'status': 'illegal-transition-commented', 'key': mutation.get('key')} (matches the existing dedup sentinel shape at applier.py:329). This shape ensures downstream manifest scrapers can distinguish 'update succeeded' from 'update fell back to comment'. Add a RED test asserting (a) update_one returns a dict on fallback with status='illegal-transition-commented', (b) the manifest persists this discriminator under mutations[i]['result'].
